title: Alhambra
text: Discovering the Alhambra with Victoria was a real pleasure. He is an attentive guide, prepared and able to convey the beauty of the place with great naturalness. We loved his way of accompanying us through history, details and suggestions, making us experience the visit in an authentic and never obvious way. A beautiful experience, made even more special by his skill. Thank you Victoria!
